annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei n° 2338, de 2023 – Dispõe sobre o uso da Inteligência Artificial (tramitação bicameral)
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 2338 of 2023 – On the Use of Artificial Intelligence (bicameral legislative tracking page)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Congresso Nacional do Brasil (Senado Federal / Câmara dos Deputados)
annotation.summary_en: Congress tracking page for Brazil's Bill 2338/2023, a general AI regulation bill introduced by Senator Rodrigo Pacheco. It logs procedural history: joint processing with other AI bills, Senate temporary committee hearings, remission to the Chamber of Deputies, and the special committee's hearing requests and bill attachments through 2026. The bill text itself is not reproduced.
key_provisions_or_claims: PL 2338/2023 introduced in the Senate on 3 May 2023 by Rodrigo Pacheco
Senate temporary AI committee (CTIA) held public hearings on regulation, health, and impacts
Sent to the Chamber of Deputies, where a special committee is reviewing it
Presidential sanction phase is still pending
